text: {"name":"cfm_chan_ctx_delete","confidence":"high","docstring":"Notifies the hardware about channel-context removal when needed, then clears the indexed 28-byte context entry.","subsystem":"cfm","var_renames":{"a1":"chan_ctx_idx","v2":"chan_ctx_table","v4":"chan_ctx"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":14,"meaning":"16-bit field reset to the 0x00FF sentinel when the context is cleared."},{"offset":24,"meaning":"Byte field whose 0xFF sentinel is checked to decide whether to notify hardware about context removal."},{"offset":25,"meaning":"Nonzero flag that gates a hardware update associated with the linked-VIF count."},{"offset":27,"meaning":"Byte field reset to the 0xFF sentinel when the context is cleared."}]}
